title: Live-Einbruchversuch und Experten-Tipps: Polizei Berlin zeigt wirksame Sicherungstechnik am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Police and a carpentry guild announce a burglary-prevention advice event on 25 October 2026 at the police headquarters foyer, including a live break-in demonstration. The event is a prevention campaign, not a specific incident.
